answer: Reward vesting with clawback resists sybils: emissions an identity earns vest over many epochs and stay seizable if fraud is later proven. A hit-and-run swarm cannot grab a payout and vanish before auditors act — its reward drains back like a river reversed, and any exposed clone has its unvested balance clawed to zero at the forge of appeal. The longer the vest, the more time detection has to reach a cheater's gains, so a tower of ivory fakes must each stay clean the whole window to keep a coin. Honest agents wait and collect. Precondition: fraud stays provable through the window.
